mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT generated.attname FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace namespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class source ON source.relnamespace = namespace.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute input ON input.attrelid = source.oid AND input.attname = #{column} AND input.attnum > 0 AND NOT input.attisdropped JOIN pg_catalog.pg_depend dependency ON dependency.refclassid = 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass AND dependency.refobjid = source.oid AND dependency.refobjsubid = input.attnum AND dependency.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_attrdef'::regclass AND dependency.deptype = 'n' JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef expression ON expression.oid = dependency.objid AND expression.adrelid = source.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute generated ON generated.attrelid = expression.adrelid AND generated.attnum = expression.adnum AND generated.attgenerated != '' AND NOT generated.attisdropped WHERE namespace.nspname = #{schema} AND source.relname = #{table} ORDER BY generated.attname

mapper.sql:
WITH projected AS ( SELECT ${_key} AS record_key, ${_key}::text AS record_id, ${_title}::text AS record_title,
${_parent}::text
NULL::text AS parent_id, ${_column} AS old_value, deleted != 0 AS is_deleted, CASE WHEN ${_column} IS NULL THEN true ELSE END AS convertible, CASE WHEN ${_column} IS NULL THEN NULL::${_type} WHEN THEN ELSE NULL::${_type} END AS target_value FROM ${_schema}.${_table} ), flags AS ( SELECT *, old_value IS NOT NULL AND NOT convertible AS conversion_issue, #{required} AND (target_value IS NULL OR COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(target_value::jsonb), 0) = 0 ) AS required_issue,
COALESCE(target_value::numeric < CAST(#{minimum} AS numeric), false)
false AS minimum_issue,
COALESCE(target_value::numeric > CAST(#{maximum} AS numeric), false)
false AS maximum_issue,
COALESCE(target_value::text !~ #{pattern}, false)
false AS pattern_issue,
CASE WHEN target_value IS NULL THEN false ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(target_value::jsonb) item(code) WHERE jsonb_exists(CAST(#{validValues} AS jsonb), item.code) NOT jsonb_exists(CAST(#{validValues} AS jsonb), item.code)
) END
CASE WHEN target_value IS NULL THEN false ELSE jsonb_exists(CAST(#{validValues} AS jsonb), target_value::text) NOT jsonb_exists(CAST(#{validValues} AS jsonb), target_value::text) END
false AS selection_issue,
target_value IS NOT NULL AND count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY target_value) > 1
false AS unique_issue FROM projected ), assessed AS ( SELECT *, array_remove(ARRAY[ CASE WHEN conversion_issue THEN 'CONVERSION' END, CASE WHEN required_issue THEN 'REQUIRED' END, CASE WHEN minimum_issue THEN 'MINIMUM' END, CASE WHEN maximum_issue THEN 'MAXIMUM' END, CASE WHEN pattern_issue THEN 'PATTERN' END, CASE WHEN selection_issue THEN 'SELECTION' END, CASE WHEN unique_issue THEN 'UNIQUE' END ]::text[], NULL) AS issue_codes FROM flags )
mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'rows', count(*), 'affected', count(old_value), 'deleted', count(*) FILTER (WHERE old_value IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted), 'reviewRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE old_value IS NOT NULL OR required_issue), 'failedRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE cardinality(issue_codes) > 0), 'conversionRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE conversion_issue), 'requiredRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE required_issue), 'minimumRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE minimum_issue), 'maximumRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE maximum_issue), 'patternRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE pattern_issue), 'selectionRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE selection_issue), 'uniqueRows', count(*) FILTER (WHERE unique_issue) )::text FROM assessed

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'id', record_id, 'title', record_title, 'parentId', parent_id, 'oldValue', old_value::text, 'newValue', CASE WHEN #{action} = 'CLEAR_COLUMN' THEN NULL ELSE target_value::text END, 'deleted', is_deleted, 'failureCodes', to_jsonb(issue_codes) )::text FROM assessed WHERE old_value IS NOT NULL OR required_issue ORDER BY record_key LIMIT #{statement.limit} OFFSET #{statement.offset}
